---
title: "Research Landscape"
description: "What SPIA graduate students and alumni study: counts by subfield, method, and research interest."
---

```{r}
source("R/site.R")

bar_list <- function(values, param, top = Inf) {
  counts <- sort(table(unlist(values)), decreasing = TRUE)
  counts <- counts[order(-counts, names(counts))]
  counts <- head(counts, top)
  mx <- max(counts)
  tags$ul(class = "bar-list", lapply(names(counts), function(k) {
    n <- as.integer(counts[[k]])
    tags$li(tags$a(
      href = paste0("index.html?", param, "=", utils::URLencode(k, reserved = TRUE)),
      `aria-label` = sprintf("%s: %d %s. Show them in the directory.", k, n,
                             if (n == 1) "person" else "people"),
      span(class = "bar-label", k),
      span(class = "bar-track", `aria-hidden` = "true",
           span(class = "bar-fill", style = sprintf("display:block;width:%.1f%%", 100 * n / mx))),
      span(class = "bar-count", `aria-hidden` = "true", n)
    ))
  }))
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(raw_block(tagList(
  test_banner(build_mode),
  breadcrumbs(list(text = "Home", href = "index.html"), list(text = "Research Landscape")),
  h1(class = "page-title", "Research Landscape"),
  p(class = "lead-red", "What the network studies. Click any row to see those people in the directory."),
  div(class = "landscape-cols",
    div(h2(class = "section-title", "Subfields"), bar_list(people$subfields, "subfield")),
    div(h2(class = "section-title", "Methods"), bar_list(people$methods, "method"))
  ),
  h2(class = "section-title", "Top 20 research interests"),
  bar_list(people$interests, "interest", top = 20),
  p(class = "figure-note",
    "People can list several subfields, methods, and interests, so counts add up to more than the number of people. ",
    "Interest tags are written by each person, so similar topics may appear under different words.")
)))
```
